entries.title: Psalms 128:1
segments: <<A Song of Ascents.>> Blessed is every one that feareth Jehovah, That walketh in his ways.

entries.title: Psalms 128:2
segments: For thou shalt eat the labor of thy hands: Happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.

entries.title: Psalms 128:3
segments: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine, In the innermost parts of thy house; Thy children like olive plants, Round about thy table.

entries.title: Psalms 128:4
segments: Behold, thus shall the man be blessed That feareth Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 128:5
segments: Jehovah bless thee out of Zion: And see thou the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.

entries.title: Psalms 128:6
segments: Yea, see thou thy children's children.  Peace be upon Israel.
